subject: Onboarding: purchase token mismatch & spend-cap correction for LumenEdge
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@lumenedge.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: accounts-payable@lumenedge.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding + PO request (LumenEdge)

Hi Logan / Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro. Attaching our completed onboarding form and W9. We have an urgent pilot starting next week and need a provisional PO (or purchase token) so our finance team can invoice and we can hit the start date.

Couple of details that may matter:
- Expected first-month spend: ~$28k, but the pilot could spike to $45k if usage is higher.
- Line items: we asked for two discrete lines (compute credits + professional services). In your onboarding portal the CSV you returned assigned everything to a single "Platform Services" SKU and put a cap of $30k — that won't work for our AP process because we need the two lines separated for internal allocation.

Can you confirm next steps and whether we can get a provisional PO number and the spend cap adjusted to $50k with line-item breakup?

Attachments: LumenEdge_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), W9_LumenEdge.pdf (PDF), PO_request_spreadsheet.xlsx (Excel)

Thanks,
Emily Stone
Vendor Operations
LumenEdge Systems
emily.stone@lumenedge.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@lumenedge.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + PO request (LumenEdge)

Hi Emily — welcome, and thanks for sending these over. Quick read-through below and next steps.

TL;DR: We can provision a temporary PO/token and increase the spend ceiling, but procurement needs to issue two explicit line items and we need one small clarification on the W-9 before finance will finalize.

Notes:
- I see how the onboarding CSV collapsed the items to a single Platform Services SKU — that's coming from a default mapping rule. Ben / Irene: can procurement override mapping for this vendor so line items are emitted separately?
- Emily: can you confirm the exact GL codes for the two lines (compute vs services)? If not, a plain-text description is OK and we will set separate line descriptions on our PO.
- Spend cap: we can provisionally set to $50,000 for 30 days. For sustained increases we'll need a signed SOW (typical).

Next steps:
1) Ben/Irene to generate provisional PO number and set spend cap to $50k for 30 days.
2) Procurement will output two line items on the provisional PO matching your spreadsheet.
3) Emily to confirm GL codes (or reply "use descriptions only").
4) Once W-9 clarifies the tax classification (Irene, see inline flag), finance will clear final PO.

I'll hand to Ben/Irene to action.

— Logan Wright
Sr. Partnerships, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Stone <emily.stone@lumenedge.com>, accounts-payable@lumenedge.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: provisional PO + line-item split for LumenEdge (HS-8921)

Irene — can you take the lead on issuing the provisional PO? Summary: LumenEdge needs a temporary PO/token so they can invoice for an imminent pilot. The onboarding export incorrectly collapsed the requested lines into a single sku, and their preferred cap is $50k (pilot window).

Details for the PO request (from attachment):
- Line 1: Compute credits — description: "Redwood inference credits (pilot)" — requested cap $30,000
- Line 2: Professional services (integration assistance) — requested cap $20,000
- Vendor: LumenEdge Systems (EIN on W9 attached)
- Billing contact: accounts-payable@lumenedge.com
- Requestor: Emily Stone, Vendor Ops
- Related hubspot deal: HS-8921

Irene — please:
- Create a provisional PO number (format PR-YYYY-XXXX) and set the provisional spend cap to $50k for 30 days; make both lines explicit on the PO; tag the PO with HS-8921.
- If you hit any tax or W-9 issues, flag to finance and loop Logan.

Emily — we will send the provisional PO number when issued. Expect a follow-up email with the PO PDF attached.

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Sales Operations
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Hi all — provisional PO created and attached.

PO summary:
- PO#: PR-2025-1542 (provisional)
- Vendor: LumenEdge Systems
- Total provisional cap: $50,000 (30 days)
- Line 1: Compute credits — $30,000 — description: "Redwood inference credits (pilot)"
- Line 2: Professional services — $20,000 — description: "Integration & onboarding services (pilot)"
- Tagged: HS-8921 (HubSpot)

Notes & next steps:
- I normalized the onboarding CSV mapping and forced two line items rather than the single Platform Services SKU. The corrected PO PDF is attached as PR-2025-1542_provisional_PO.pdf (attachment).
- Finance did a quick W-9 check: EIN matches our vendor lookup; no further tax docs required for provisional issuance.
- This is provisional — once the pilot completes or if monthly run rate remains above $35k, we will request a formal SOW and an annual PO.

Emily — please confirm you received the PO and that line descriptions meet your AP needs. If you need GL codes inserted, reply with them and I will amend.

Thanks,
